description: Internal alterations to support educational use
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [insert plan numbers/documents].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good for the retained fabric, shall match the original work in type, colour, texture, profile and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution, including facebond and pointing.

Condition : 5 - All existing architectural features including staircases, balustrades, windows, doors, architraves, skirtings, dados, picture rails, panel work, fireplaces, tiling, corbelled arches, cornices, decorative ceilings and other decorative features shall be retained except where otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority and shall be protected from damage during the course of the works hereby approved.

For the avoidance of doubt, fixing points for any handrail or railing into any part of the existing building shall be kept at a minimum and shall be made into the mortar joints between the stones using non-ferrous fixings; where this is required, full details of these fixings shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Planning Authority prior to any works on site.
